title: Add reusable assignment flags and task rendering
description: Add repeatable --reusable NAME_OR_ID to modern task create and task update/edit, plus compatible legacy create parsing. Preserve flag occurrence order. On update, any --reusable occurrence replaces the entire list; a single --reusable= clears it; reject mixed empty/non-empty occurrences and duplicates. Thread parsed identifiers through provider inputs without locally resolving them. Extend detailed human task output and claim output with an ordered reusable items section containing each name, title, and instructions; keep compact task list and graph columns unchanged. Ensure JSON task views expose stored reusableTaskIds and resolved reusableTasks consistently. Add parser, legacy parity, human/JSON rendering, clear/reorder, show/start/next, multiline instruction, and usage-error tests.
